title: Repair ISBN checksum weights
instructions:
Fix the two checksum-weight bugs in `isbn.py`. The existing module's validation,
normalization, and conversion depend on these calculations; preserve its API.

## Files
- `isbn.py`

All public functions take a string; non-string input raises `TypeError`. Before any
processing, remove ASCII spaces and hyphens anywhere and uppercase the remainder.
No other whitespace is removed. Digits mean ASCII `0` through `9` only.
- `check_digit10(prefix) -> str`: require exactly nine digits after compaction,
  otherwise `ValueError`. Multiply them left-to-right by 10,9,...,2. The check
  value makes the total divisible by 11; return `X` for 10, otherwise its digit.
- `check_digit13(prefix) -> str`: require exactly twelve digits after compaction,
  otherwise `ValueError`. Weights alternate 1,3,1,3,... starting with 1. Return
  the digit which makes the total divisible by 10.
- `is_valid(text) -> bool`: accept ten characters with nine digits and a final
  digit or X, or thirteen digits, only when the checksum matches. Malformed strings
  return False. Do not enforce publisher or 978/979 registration-prefix rules.
- `normalize(text) -> str`: return compact uppercase text for a valid ISBN;
  invalid strings raise `ValueError`.
- `to_isbn13(text) -> str`: validate first. Return an ISBN-13 unchanged after
  normalization. Convert ISBN-10 by prefixing `978` to its first nine digits and
  computing a new ISBN-13 check digit. Invalid strings raise `ValueError`.
